content.short: Pixels is a popular open-world Web3 farming and exploration MMORPG built natively on the Ronin gaming network.
content.description: Pixels is a leading Web3-native social MMORPG that invites players to build, gather, and explore a vast, pixelated virtual world. Originally launched on Polygon, the game migrated to the Ronin Network to leverage its high throughput and player-centric infrastructure. Participants can own NFT-based land plots, craft valuable items, and collaborate with a global community to earn on-chain rewards. The ecosystem is powered by the $PIXEL token, which facilitates in-game transactions and governance, emphasizing player sovereignty and digital ownership in a vibrant virtual economy.
